BetaManagedAgentsSessionThreadStats.description: Timing statistics for a session thread.

active_seconds.description: Cumulative time in seconds the thread spent actively running. Excludes idle time.

duration_seconds.description: Elapsed time since thread creation in seconds. For archived threads, frozen at the final update.

startup_seconds.description: Time in seconds for the thread to begin running. Zero for child threads, which start immediately.

BetaManagedAgentsSessionThreadUsage.description: Cumulative token usage for a session thread across all turns.

active_seconds.description: Cumulative time in seconds this thread spent in running status. Equal to `stats.active_seconds`; surfaced here so a thread's usage carries every quantity its cost is priced on.

cache_creation.description: Tokens used to create prompt cache entries, broken down by cache TTL.

cache_read_input_tokens.description: Total tokens read from prompt cache.

input_tokens.description: Total input tokens consumed across all turns.

list_cost.description: Cumulative list cost of this thread across all turns, priced at public list rates. Absent until cost tracking is available for the thread. Each figure is rounded to the nearest cent independently and the session's aggregate `usage.list_cost` additionally includes session runtime, so per-thread costs do not sum exactly to the session figure; the session figure is authoritative and is what a budget is enforced against.

output_tokens.description: Total output tokens generated across all turns.

server_tool_use.description: Cumulative server-executed tool usage across all turns of this thread. Absent until server-tool tracking is available for the thread.

BetaManagedAgentsSessionThreadAgent.description: Resolved `agent` definition for a single `session_thread`. Snapshot of the agent at thread creation time. The multiagent roster is not repeated here; read it from `Session.agent`.

BetaMonetaryAmount.description: A monetary amount in a specific currency.

amount.description: Amount in minor units of the currency, as an integer decimal string with no leading zeros: "2500" is $25.00 and "50" is fifty cents. A string rather than a number so no float rounding is ever applied.

currency.description: Uppercase ISO-4217 currency code. `USD` is the only currency currently supported; the accepted set is closed and grows only when a new currency is priced.

BetaManagedAgentsServerToolUsage.description: Cumulative count of server-executed tool invocations, broken down by tool.

web_fetch_requests.description: Number of server-executed web fetch requests.

web_search_requests.description: Number of server-executed web search requests.

effort.description: How hard Claude works on each inference call. One of `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, `max`. Always present; resolved to the per-model default at save time when not supplied.

inference_geo.description: Geographic region for model inference. When unset, requests fall through to the workspace's default_inference_geo.

speed.description: Inference speed mode. `fast` provides significantly faster output token generation at premium pricing. Defaults to `standard`. Not all models support `fast`; invalid combinations are rejected at create time.

BetaManagedAgentsCustomTool.description: A custom tool as returned in API responses.

BetaManagedAgentsEffortLow.description: Low effort. Favors latency over reasoning depth.

BetaManagedAgentsEffortMedium.description: Medium effort. Balances latency and reasoning depth.

BetaManagedAgentsEffortXhigh.description: Extra-high effort. Not all models accept this level.

BetaManagedAgentsEffortMax.description: Maximum effort. Favors reasoning depth over latency.

BetaManagedAgentsAgentToolConfigUnion.description: Configuration for a specific agent tool.

BetaManagedAgentsAgentToolsetDefaultConf.description: Resolved default configuration for agent tools.

BetaManagedAgentsMCPToolConfig.description: Resolved configuration for a specific MCP tool.

BetaManagedAgentsMCPToolsetDefaultConfig.description: Resolved default configuration for all tools from an MCP server.

BetaManagedAgentsCustomToolInputSchema.description: JSON Schema for custom tool input parameters.

url_sources.description: Which sources contribute URLs the tool may fetch, always in the object form. Null when not set, which allows every source.

BetaManagedAgentsWebFetchUrlSources.description: Which sources contribute URLs the web_fetch tool may fetch. A key that is null was not set and allows every URL from that source.

client_tool_results.description: Which custom tools' results contribute URLs that may be fetched. Null when not set, which allows every custom tool's results.

server_tool_results.description: Which of the web_search and web_fetch tools' results contribute URLs that may be fetched. Null when not set, which allows both.

user_input.description: Whether URLs in the text of user messages may be fetched. Null when not set, which allows them.

BetaManagedAgentsUserLocation.description: Approximate user location for search result localization.

BetaManagedAgentsAlwaysAllowPolicy.description: Tool calls are automatically approved without user confirmation.

BetaManagedAgentsAlwaysAskPolicy.description: Tool calls require user confirmation before execution.

BetaManagedAgentsAutoPolicy.description: The server decides each tool call individually: it judges, from the tool, its input, and the session content so far, whether the call is safe to execute or high-risk, and evaluates it to allow when judged safe and to deny when judged high-risk. A call the server cannot reach a judgement on evaluates to ask.

BetaManagedAgentsWebFetchUrlSourceToolFi.description: Which tools' results contribute URLs that may be fetched.

BetaManagedAgentsWebFetchUrlSourceUserIn.description: Whether URLs in the text of user messages may be fetched.

BetaManagedAgentsWebFetchUrlSourceAll.description: Every URL from this source may be fetched. This is the default.

BetaManagedAgentsWebFetchUrlSourceNone.description: This source contributes no URLs that may be fetched.

BetaManagedAgentsWebFetchUrlSourceOnly.description: Only the named tools' results contribute URLs that may be fetched.

tools.description: The tools whose results contribute. Between 1 and 128 entries, each with a different name. An empty list is rejected; use "none" to allow no tool's results.

BetaManagedAgentsWebFetchUrlSourceExcept.description: Every tool's results contribute URLs that may be fetched, except the named tools' results.

tools.description: The tools whose results do not contribute. Between 1 and 128 entries, each with a different name. An empty list is rejected; use "all" to leave out no tool's results.

BetaManagedAgentsWebFetchUrlSourceToolRe.description: Names one tool in an only or except list.

name.description: Name of the tool. Compared exactly, so upper and lower case letters are different.
